{{Top|leg}}
An '''Individual atmospheric intrusion pod''' was a pod used to enter a planet from its atmosphere. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], members of [[Wraith Squadron]] and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] used such pods to enter [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during [[Mission to Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|their mission]] undetected. The pods burnt during their descent, giving them the appearance of falling meteors. [[Kell Tainer]] considered them to be 'pretty new'. They were not airtight, however, and required the members to wear [[Environment suit/Legends|vac suits]]. Their pods consisted of devices mounted inside hollowed-out [[Yorik-et|Coralskippers]]. The devices had an [[Ablative heatshield|ablative heat shield]] on the bottom, and a simple [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] unit and [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] near the top to keep the pods correctly angled towards the planet's surface.
